title: Electrobot Starter Kit (70 ITEMS) 20+ DIY Projects with Electronics Components Breadboard, LEDs, Resistors, Switches etc
bullets: This kit includes electronic components - breadboard, transistors, seven segment display, LEDs, capacitor, resistors, buzzer, battery, DIP Switch, etc. 22+ Electrics-based projects can be made from the kit. Projects covered in the kit are digit display, water level indicator, Flip Flop and many more.
Educational Objective: STEM Education Awareness, Develops Creative and Logical Thinking.
Learn how to solve real world problems by making several trendy DIY projects.
Live online assistance (Doubt solving session) and STEM accredited e - Certificate on completion.
